priority_experiment.result: Inconclusive; not packaged as a workaround.
priority_experiment.comparison: Apps held at hiprio. Removing the Phoc override produced 91 -> 101 logged fault lines on first NGL editor opening. Restoring it held 101. Repeating without it also held 101. Counts are rate-limited log lines, not total hardware faults.
priority_experiment.queue_trace: Default Phoc already requests priority0 for its main EGL context. Helper queues request priority1. GTK NGL application contexts request priority6 normally, priority0 with hiprio. Both application settings passed the short traced comparison, which does not prove either stable.
priority_experiment.limits: No causal fix or cross-ring preemption diagnosis established. Trace was a temporary ioctl logger; no kernel scheduling patch was made.

desktop_faults.status: Premature unmapping addressed by 0032; its missing cleanup addressed by 0033. Package-33 validation below.
desktop_faults.root_cause: Kernel regression since 6.17 (111fdd2198e6, drm/msm drm_gpuvm conversion). msm_gem_close() unmaps and frees a BO's VMA in the closing context's VM. a5xx has no per-process pagetables, so every context shares the global VM and a dma-buf shared between a GTK GL client and phoc is one GEM object with one VMA. When the client closed its handle (old window buffers on open/resize/close), phoc's mapping went too; Mesa keeps the cached iova, so phoc read unmapped addresses (or another BO given that iova). v6.12 and v6.16 only updated memory accounting on close. Cairo windows use wl_shm and did not add faults in the recorded phase comparison.
desktop_faults.fix: Patch 0032 keeps the shared GPU mapping while other users still need it. Patch 0033 releases it at the final external VMA reference, after waiting for GPU work. The existing counter covers handles, dma-buf exports and framebuffers. Upstream status and wider GPU coverage need review before submission.

cleanup_review.package32: 4197 objects / 1933180928 bytes total, 1930604544 resident, unchanged after greetd and phosh stopped.
cleanup_review.reason: drm_gpuvm_bo_create takes a GEM reference; drm_gpuva_link holds the vm_bo. Skipping all global-VM teardown leaves a reference cycle. The final GEM destructor cannot break that cycle itself.
cleanup_review.package33: Extends existing vma_ref cleanup to the global GPU VM, waits for outstanding work, and uses existing VM/object locks. Keeps display cleanup and skips absent GPUs.
cleanup_review.host_tests: 34 tests passed, including compiled lifecycle tests with and without KMS: shared references keep mappings, final release performs cleanup, GPU work is awaited, and unloaded GPUs are handled.
